summary: John's 7th-great-grandmother, mother of Keturah Tuttle; a granddaughter of Job Smith and great-granddaughter of Richard 'Bull' Smith, founder of Smithtown.
bio:
Temperance is the link that carries the whole Smith, Thompson, Topping, Hammond and Paine ancestry. Pelletreau's appendix (p. 479) says James Smith 'settled in Moriches' and married Jerusha Topping, and lists their children as Matthew (b. 1721), Ezekiel, Zebulon, Austin, Nathaniel, Francis, Eunice, Keturah, Temperance and Jeremiah. Temperance Tuttle named her eldest known daughter Keturah (after her sister) and a son Ezekiel (after her brother); Keturah in turn named children James (1774), Temperance (1778) and Keturah (1791). Two of her brothers, Capt. Francis Smith and Capt. Austin Smith, commanded the Woodbury Clove and Upper Clove militia companies in Orange County in 1775–76, with her son-in-law Thomas Lamoreaux as ensign under Francis. Earlier research had a rival candidate: Ebenezer Smith (son of Richard 2d) whose will of 25 Jul 1747 (proved 7 Jan 1747 O.S.; Pelletreau p. 46) left £100 each to 'my daughters Temperance Anna and Hannah' when 21, with wife Anna daughter of Job Smith 2d (p. 472). Pelletreau's appendix (pp. 465, 475) says twice that this Temperance married Jonas Platt and died 12 Mar 1813 his widow, so she cannot be Mrs. Tuttle; that candidacy is closed. Job Smith 2d's daughter Temperance (b. 1714) is about 20 years too early. A chronology question was raised (Jerusha's father 'died in 1705') and resolved in Round 1: Jerusha's father was the younger Elnathan Topping (1664–1751), not Capt. Elnathan (d. 1705). No grave found. A full-text search of Pelletreau found no Tuthill/Tuttle tied to her.

Temperance is now named as a daughter of James Smith & Jerusha Topping of Moriches in two independent printed genealogies that predate Alva Tuttle (1968). Pelletreau (1898) lists the children as Matthew (b. 3 Sept 1721), Ezekiel, Zebulon, Austin, Nathaniel, Francis, Eunice, Keturah, Temperance and Jeremiah ([R4-S1]). C. H. Weygant's Family Record (1897), written for the Weygant family, who married into Capt. Francis Smith's line, lists nine children: Nathan [sic, for Matthew], Ezekiel, Austin, Nathaniel, Francis, Eunice, Keturah, Temperance and Jerusha ([R4-S2]). Neither source names her husband, so the step 'this Temperance = Mrs. John Tuthill' still rests on Alva Tuttle and on circumstantial evidence. That evidence is the Woodbury Clove militia under her brothers and the naming of Keturah's children.

Two cautions. (1) Her first cousin, Temperance daughter of Job Smith 2d, was born 19 June 1714 ([R4-S1]). She is too old to be Mrs. Tuthill (m. 1752), but she is a likely source of confusion in online trees. (2) The eldest brother Matthew was born in 1721, so Temperance, as one of the youngest, fits a birth c.1732-35.

Name in the Ancestry tree: "* Temperance SMITH"; research uses "Temperance Smith".

Resolved: F. K. Smith (1967) entry under James Smith of Moriches: does it name Temperance as Mrs. John Tuthill? → Still unread. The book is borrow-only on archive.org (familyofrichards00smit), and its full-text search endpoint returned 'Item not available'. WikiTree Smith-105759 cites it at p. 91 but does not quote it. Partly answered instead by Pelletreau and Weygant, who both list Temperance but give no husband.
Round 4 relationship evidence (parent I282608065087, probable): Named among James Smith's children by Pelletreau (1898) and Weygant (1897); Alva Tuttle (1968) supplies the marriage to John Tuthill
Round 4 relationship evidence (parent I282608065103, probable): Same sources

Round 4 searched without result: NY marriage licenses before 1784 (1860 printed list, full text): no Tuthill/Tuttle-Smith license; no Lamoreaux-Tuthill license; Abstracts of Wills, NY Surrogate (NYHS Collections), all volumes 1730-1784 on archive.org, full text: no will or administration for John Tuthill of Cornwall/Woodbury Clove, James Tuthill (d. c.1772) or Temperance Tuthill; no will of James Smith of Moriches; archive.org full-text search inside F. K. Smith 1967 (borrow-only): blocked ('Item not available')
Round 4: Weygant's Family Record (1897) gives a second pre-1968 printed source naming Temperance as daughter of James Smith & Jerusha Topping; no marriage record found.

conflicts.site: Jerusha Topping, daughter of Elnathan Topping Jr. (research) / Josiah Topping & Hannah Sayre (tree)
conflicts.found: Weygant 1897: daughter of Elnathan Topping Jr., son of Capt. Elnathan; Genealogies of the State of New York vol. 2 (as quoted on WikiTree): daughter of 'Jonathan (2) and Mary Topping'
conflicts.assessment: Weygant (1897) independently supports the Elnathan Jr. identification. 'Jonathan' looks like a misreading of Elnathan, since Elnathan Jr.'s wife was also Mary. The Josiah/Sayre version (C. E. Topping 1980) stays rejected.
